lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The spots show a semi-regular grid distribution with higher density in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, creating a grid-like framework where the primary white blobs are positioned at the intersections of these faint vertical stripes and horizontal alignments.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal ridge is visible along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a highlight on the superior edge and a linear shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Three remoras are visible: one attached to the dorsal surface, one swimming near the pectoral fin, and one positioned on the mid-lateral flank.
